tools.name: search_bills
tools.description: Search bills by text and optionally narrow the state, session year mode and result page.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: Search terms, for example renewable energy.

tools.name: get_bill
tools.description: Get details for a bill ID returned by search.

arguments.name: bill_id
arguments.description: Numeric bill ID from a search result.

tools.name: get_roll_call
tools.description: Get the recorded votes for a roll-call ID from bill details.

arguments.name: roll_call_id
arguments.description: Numeric roll-call ID from bill details.
